svg.title: Kivi: complete memory architecture and flow
svg.desc: Regular dictation provides history. Hey Kivi coordinates private input, recall, model proposals, controls and checked results. MemoryService learns, retrieves and controls evidence-backed knowledge over the same SQLite database as ordinary application data. All product components are planned.

text.tspan: One product story: dictate a trip budget, use it later, change it, inspect it and forget it.
PROPOSED ARCHITECTURE • App unbuilt • Only the isolated SQLite probe has passed 12/12 checks
Write what the person intends; existing product context.
Raw ASR + formatted text + available metadata. Our demo
Help with the current request, using relevant permitted history.
Accept private input; hold its learning job.
Answer, draft, focused question or honest
Application rules + durable understanding. All routes use the same permission,
Validate import; save exact source revision + durable job. Permitted
source search is independent of extraction.
Background worker uses the shared model. Keep speaker, subject,
scope, time, negation and exact support.
Add / revise / link / no-op / preserve conflict / reject. Commit
accepted memory, evidence and index jobs together.
Check trusted user, scope, relevant time and current exclusions.
FTS5 keywords first. Optional vectors help with meaning; supported
Inspect exact spans; combine and deduplicate. Include sources,
conflicts, coverage and a freshness token.
Remember / correct / change / forget / delete source. Check scope,
time and expected version; clarify ambiguity.
Knowledge, exclusions, permitted text, affected indexes / links,
revision and actual receipt change atomically.
Suppress affected derivatives, jobs and replay; rebuild from
surviving evidence. Source deletion has a separate boundary.
Full lists and counts need completeness checks.
A real-world change preserves earlier history.
Forget also blocks known supporting spans.
MEMORY RECORD = attributed claim + subject / scope + time + exact source evidence + status / revision.
Example: Jaipur trip · total hotel budget · 6000 INR · original supporting phrase. Twelve categories are labels on shared records.
D ONE REGULAR PRODUCT DATABASE · SQLite
Shared storage and transaction boundary. MemoryService gives these records their learning, retrieval and control behavior.
Jobs / runs / operation outcomes / control receipts
Subjects / scope / time · supported aliases / relationships
FTS5 source + memory indexes · optional local vectors
Vectors locate candidates; evidence supports answers.
Python: explicit request order. Pydantic: data-shape checks.
SQLite: related changes commit together. HTTPX: bounded model calls.
Exact evidence; qualified meaning; one exclusion boundary.
Short transactions, repeat-safe keys, stale-worker rejection and fresh publication.
Build the real UI + backend, corpus and model integration.
Measure quality, latency, failures and cost; vectors remain optional.
ONE EXAMPLE: dictate INR 6,000 → learn trip-scoped budget → draft with evidence → change to INR 8,000 → inspect → forget across all retrieval routes.

Arrow colors: blue = live request / evidence; green = learning (dashed = background); amber = controls; purple = shared DB access. Sources: ARCHITECTURE.md v1.1 §§0–12; Golden Goose brief. 6 Sep 2026.
